findings.message: `drive_id` is a new keyword on `GoogleSheetsCreateSpreadsheetOperator.__init__` and its `:param:` entry records a real behaviour change - with `drive_id` set, everything in `spreadsheet` except `properties.title` is discarded. Nothing under `providers/google/docs/operators/` is touched in this PR, so DAG authors reading the published Sheets guide never see the option or that caveat. Update the operator's RST guide in the same change.
